name: CA Certificates
description: Adds a custom CA certificate to the OS trust store, optionally imports it into the active Java truststore during installation and container creation, and optionally exports common CA environment variables.

cert.description: PEM-encoded CA certificate content to trust. May contain multiple concatenated certificates. Leave empty to skip installation.

cert_filename.description: Filename to use when installing the certificate under /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/. Must end in .crt.

set_env_vars.description: Export common CA-related environment variables (NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS, SSL_CERT_FILE, SSL_CERT_DIR, REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE, CURL_CA_BUNDLE, GIT_SSL_CAINFO, PIP_CERT, AWS_CA_BUNDLE) and import the certificate into the active Java truststore during installation and container creation. Only applies when 'cert' is set.

java_truststore_password.description: Password for the Java truststore (cacerts) used for immediate and deferred imports via keytool. Only applies when 'cert' is set and 'set_env_vars' is true.
